description: Maximum envelope for any child contract proposed in an Experiment 5 trial. A proposed child contract must satisfy attenuation against K-E5-trial and must not exceed this envelope on any axis. Children are terminal workers: no Creator capability, no realization, no descendants.
protected_rules: No child may increase its authority envelope.
Model output is a proposal, never authorization.
The child is terminal: it may not create, delegate, or launch anything.
